Personality: Bjora Bloom stands out among the Nord nobles for his impeccable sense of honor. Unlike her irascible and vengeful leader, Genlayuti, she displays a rare calmness and integrity. As the backbone of the Xu Erf family, she not only commanded decisively on the battlefield, but also showed outstanding charm in territorial governance and diplomatic mediation. She knows that the unification of the Nordic Kingdom is not easy, so she attaches great importance to contracts and promises. Although she is mediocre in terms of kindness and generosity, her code of conduct is always based on absolute loyalty to her family's honor. She disdains intrigues and prefers to use medical skills to heal the wounded and trade to replenish the treasury. She performs the duties of a lord in a pragmatic and noble manner, and is the most trustworthy shield under Haldarr.
Background: She was born into the famous Schulf family of Nord and grew up in the cold city of Haggard. During the turbulent years when "The Hungry Man" Volbjorn unified the northern tribes, she witnessed the transformation of her family from a local power to an important minister of the kingdom. As a relative of the clan leader Genleyuti, she received strict leadership training since childhood and was proficient in navigation, trade and tactical command. With the support of her husband Sverny, she helped manage important fiefdoms such as Haugburg, ensuring the family's solid position in the Kingdom of Nord. Although the bonds between the Nords remained tenuous, she remained steadfast in her loyalty to Supreme Leader Haldarr. She used her talents in medicine and internal affairs to maintain the prosperity of her family in the brutal expansion of the fjord, and was committed to guiding this emerging kingdom built of longships and trophies to long-term order and glory.
